working_tree_semantics: Round 3.1 was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Existing user documentation changes were preserved. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

authority_contract.conversation_input_truth_owner: CanonicalProviderInputReader over one exact canonical cut
authority_contract.continuity_owner: one Host-scoped process-local ROOT epoch plus at most four active child epochs
authority_contract.system_contract: only stable BASE_SYSTEM remains in the system prompt
authority_contract.dynamic_source_contract: runtime, clock, permission, Plan, catalog, and skill facts append as typed causal runtime observations; Plan display render is separate from exact transition occurrence identity
authority_contract.old_item_contract: installed canonical items and tool-result render decisions are immutable prefix facts
authority_contract.dispatch_order: preflight -> process-local continuity compare-and-swap -> one-shot provider open
authority_contract.tool_surface_borrow: one exact Host-authority borrow covers provider response, assistant acceptance, authorization, attempt acceptance, physical invoke, and tool-result settlement

strict_prefix_contract.cohort: same Host + same exact ROOT or SUBAGENT_TASK scope + same epoch compatibility
strict_prefix_contract.tools: descriptor, schema, binding, and order exact equal

steer_contract.busy_enter: STEER_ACTIVE_TURN against the exact active ROOT turn
steer_contract.delivery_order: strict FIFO inside each same-table lane; no cross-lane delivery blocking
steer_contract.safe_point_order: freeze predecessor and base cut -> pin target and tool surface -> freeze one-cut sources -> read pending steer facts -> compile and quote longest acceptable FIFO prefix -> consume or exact-confirm -> reread canonical exact join -> promote the same precompiled input -> preflight/CAS/open
steer_contract.planning_deadline: one absolute cooperative deadline across fingerprint, lowering, degradation, layout, and first-party estimator loops; the physical worker exits before timeout or close returns
steer_contract.single_head_resource_failure: queue rejection, turn interruption, PromptRejected, and TurnInterrupted are one Host-writer transaction
steer_contract.ack_unknown: stable prepared identity with FULL, NONE, or CONFLICT confirmation

verification.install_permit_authority: Host-owner-sealed exact-object identity; forged same-shape permit rejected before provider open
verification.steer_planning_unique_work: immutable base charged once; sixteen-to-one longest-first regression reaches the valid FIFO prefix
verification.first_party_source_union: every closed registry kind is exactly VALUE or ABSENT; absent policy drift and missing branches fail before provider open

real_provider_dogfood.post_review_reuse_basis: The post-review changes leave provider wire lowering unchanged; adapter-final strict-prefix tests, full Python, and Go gates were rerun. Cached-token observations remain best-effort evidence from the original activation run.
real_provider_dogfood.configuration: one configured OpenAI-compatible provider; detected MCP servers were disabled only inside each ephemeral dogfood workspace
real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral database per run, force-dropped after verification; the user database was untouched

production_diff.counting_scope: tracked diff under src and clients plus three untracked Round 3.1 production modules

non_goals: long-horizon compaction or context snapshot generation
cross-Host prefix restore or exact historical provider-request replay
provider cache accounting as a correctness gate
